text.label: Text: You are a coach, an author or an influencer. People already
text.value: You are a coach, an author or an influencer. People already pay attention to you. You already sell what you know, or you are ready to. And you would rather have the whole thing built right than spend the next year learning how to build it yourself. Done For You is for the person who is ready to have it built now.

text.label: Text: What we are.
text.value: What we are.

text.label: Text: Steven James Consulting is a modern day talent agency. A tal
text.value: Steven James Consulting is a modern day talent agency. A talent agent does the work behind the stage so the talent can do the one thing they are great at. My team and I take coaches, authors and influencers and show them how to make money with their attention and their product, and then we do the building for them. Our whole model is one line: Attention + Your Product = Dollars.

text.label: Text: What gets built.
text.value: What gets built.

text.label: Text: A fifteen-stage system. It starts with your email and it end
text.value: A fifteen-stage system. It starts with your email and it ends with a team keeping everything running. In between are your phone number, your social channels, your product, your e-book, your AI employees, your website, your podcast and the six business systems that turn people who watch you into people who pay you. Every stage is on this page, by name, in the order we build it.

text.label: Text: Who does the work.
text.value: Who does the work.

text.label: Text: My team does. This is a company with a team behind the work,
text.value: My team does. This is a company with a team behind the work, and I am on your account personally. You are not asked to learn software, and neither is anybody who works with you. You tell us what you know, you show up to record, and you check that it sounds like you.

text.label: Text: Why fifteen.
text.value: Why fifteen.

text.label: Text: Because that is how many it takes. Most people picture a web
text.value: Because that is how many it takes. Most people picture a website, or a podcast, or a book. Each of those is one stage. On its own, one stage does very little. A website with nobody arriving is a brochure. An audience with nothing to buy stays an audience. The money shows up when all of it is built and every piece is connected to the next one. That is the work you are asking my team to do.

text.value: Attention + Your Product = Dollars.

text.label: Text: First, the ground.

We set all of it up in your name, once, the right way.

text.value: Stages four and five turn what you know into something a person can buy. We get it out of your head and write it down. We give it a name, a price and a look. Then we put it in a book with your name on the cover. This is the part most experts never finish alone, because it is hard to see what you know from the outside. Seeing it from the outside is our job.

You record once and you show up everywhere, all week, and every piece tells the viewer the same thing: go to the website.

text.label: Text: Then, the money already sitting there.

Everyone who followed you, bought once or went quiet gets reached again with the next thing you offer. Paid ads come last, and only if you want them.
